Visit website Pricing Paid No free plan Platforms Web, API API available Launched 11 August 2025 First public release Reviewed by Tomás Beltrán 15 October 2026 The review, written by Tomás Beltrán after using it for real work. Recado handles the admin nobody wants: booking a venue, comparing quotes, chasing an invoice. It works in a browser like you would, and shows every step. It always asks before spending money, which made us comfortable giving it real tasks. Some sites block it, and there is no free plan. For small teams drowning in admin, it is the most useful agent we tested. The verdict, what worked for us and what we would change.
